validation.positiveInt: Must be a whole number of 1 or more
validation.tempRequired: Temperature range is required for this storage type
validation.tempNotAllowed: Dry zones have no temperature range
validation.tempBoth: Enter both minimum and maximum, or neither
validation.tempOrder: Minimum must not be above maximum
validation.tooManySlots: Too many slots in one request (max {{max}})
validation.oneWarehouse: Staff belong to exactly one warehouse
validation.amount: Enter a valid amount, e.g. 150000 or 2500.50
validation.endBeforeStart: End date must not be before the start date
validation.eway: An e-way bill number has 12 digits
validation.expiryBeforeMfg: Expiry cannot be before the manufacturing date
validation.lorry: Enter a valid lorry number, e.g. TN 01 AB 1234
validation.pan: Enter a valid PAN, e.g. ABCDE1234F
validation.panMismatch: PAN does not match the GSTIN
validation.storageOrTemp: Choose a storage type or enter a required temperature
validation.days: Enter a whole number of days (0 to 999)
validation.passwordStrong: Use a capital letter, a small letter and a number

auth.forgotHelp: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
auth.linkSent: If the email exists, a reset link has been sent.
auth.mustChange: Please set a new password before continuing.
auth.noAccessBody: Your account does not have access to the warehouse modules. Please contact the administrator.
auth.inactiveBody: Your account has been deactivated. Please contact the administrator.
auth.forbiddenBody: You do not have permission to open this page.
auth.recoveryMissing: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong passwords. Wait {{minutes}} minute(s) and try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: No zones yet. Create a warehouse and zones to see the summary.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.codeHelp: Used in slot codes, e.g. W1. Leave blank to auto-generate.
warehouses.name: Warehouse name
warehouses.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? Users keep their history but it will be marked inactive.

zones.title: Zones
zones.codeHelp: e.g. Z1. Leave blank to auto-generate.
zones.deleteConfirm: Delete zone {{name}}? Its slots remain in the history.

slots.title: Slot Builder
slots.preview: This will create up to {{count}} slots.
slots.pickZone: Pick a warehouse and zone to see and build slots.

users.title: Managers & Staff
users.tempPasswordHelp: Share it securely. The user must change it at first login.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They will lose access immediately.
users.accountantHelp: An accountant sees billing for every warehouse and can export, but cannot change anything.

hiring.title: Hiring
hiring.accountCreated: Account created and applicant marked as joined
hiring.salaryHint: Only the administrator can see salary.
hiring.resumePrivate: Stored privately. Only the administrator and this warehouse's manager can open it.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.maskedNote: Bank details, ID proof and device keys are never written here: they show as ***.

clients.title: Clients
clients.gstinHelp: 15 characters. The state and PAN are filled from it.
clients.pickRuleHelp: Order in which batches are dispatched.
clients.billingCycleHelp: Weekly and monthly cycles create DRAFT invoices automatically; on demand means an administrator generates them.
clients.groupHelp: Clients in a group can share a rate card.
clients.billingOverrideHelp: If this client is blocked for overdue or over-limit bills, an override lets it book and dispatch until the date you choose.
clients.warehousesHelp: Managers and staff see this client only if it is linked to their warehouse. A client is linked automatically when it is added at a warehouse or has a gate entry, booking or contract there.
clients.loginPasswordHint: Fill this to create the client's login with the email above. Leave blank to skip. At least 10 characters with capital, small letter and number.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.rateNote: Rates are added in the next phase.

companies.title: Sender & receiver companies
companies.empty: No companies yet. Add the companies this client sends goods from or to.
companies.name: Company name
companies.pageHelp: Companies your clients receive goods from or send goods to. Add them here, or on the spot at the gate or in a dispatch request.

bookings.title: Space Booking
bookings.setpointHelp: Exact temperature the goods need, or give a band below.
bookings.noMatchingZone: No zone in this warehouse can hold that temperature.
bookings.cancelHelp: Reserved empty slots go back to free.
bookings.clientHelp: Request space; the warehouse manager approves it and reserves slots for you.

gate.title: Gate Entry
gate.noLines: No load lines yet. Add what is on the lorry.
gate.companyBothHelp: This company can be used both as the sender (inward) and the receiver (dispatch).

receive.title: Inward receipt
receive.slotHelp: Suggestions use the client's reserved slots first and only zones that match the temperature. You can change any slot.
receive.labourHelp: Handling facts for later billing. No money is calculated now.
receive.readyHint: Everything is counted and placed. Confirm to create the receipt and stock.
receive.notReadyHint: Place every counted quantity in a slot and fill workers and hours.
receive.notReceivable: This gate entry is {{status}} and cannot be received.

problem.good: Good quantity differs from the slots
problem.damaged: Damaged quantity differs from the slots
problem.noSlot: Choose a slot for every row

receive.labourSkip: Not needed to receive. Add it only if you want to record the labour.

receipts.title: Inward Receipts
receipts.cancelHelp: The stock is taken out again by new ledger entries. This is only possible while the goods are untouched.
receipts.lookupHint: Type the receipt number, e.g. GR/W1/2627/0001

stock.title: Stock
stock.adjustHelp: Current quantity: {{qty}}. The change is written to the ledger with your reason.

labels.title: QR Labels
labels.help: Print labels for slots and pallets. Scanning them works in picking and in the scan page.
labels.pickZone: Choose a zone to print its slot labels.

scan.title: Scan
scan.help: Scan a slot or batch label to see what is there.

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.pickClientFirst: Choose a client first, then you can add a company.
dispatch.noStock: This client has no available stock in this warehouse.
dispatch.lineIncomplete: Choose an item and a quantity on every row.
dispatch.clientHelp: Ask for goods to be sent to one of your companies. The warehouse approves and dispatches.
dispatch.scanHelp: Scan each slot or batch label. A wrong batch is refused.
dispatch.tapHelp: Take each item from the slot shown, then tap "Mark picked".

challans.title: Delivery Challans
challans.cancelHelp: The goods go back into their slots by new ledger entries.

portal.help: You see only your own stock and documents. Request space or a dispatch from the menu; the warehouse will approve it.
portal.noStock: No stock in the warehouse right now.

billing.defaultFromTaxRules: Leave blank to use the tax rules
billing.draftCreated: Draft invoice created: check every line, then issue it
billing.modeHelp: Rent uses the daily occupancy snapshots; labour uses confirmed receipts and challans not billed before.
billing.draftHelp: Draft: nothing is final. Fix a line (with a reason), add charges, then issue. An issued invoice can never be edited; corrections are credit or debit notes.
billing.discountAppliesAfter: The section discount is applied to this amount.
billing.removeLineHelp: The rent days or the document become billable again.
billing.discardHelp: The rent days and documents in this draft become billable again.
billing.issueHelp: Issuing gives the invoice its number and locks it for ever. Check every line first.
billing.noteHelp: A note is linked to invoice {{no}}. Invoices are never edited.
billing.paymentHelp: More than is owed stays as an advance. Without an invoice it settles the oldest first.
billing.reverseHelp: The payment is cancelled and its invoices become payable again.
billing.utilisationHelp: Brigade-days held, billed and available in the period.
billing.supplierHelp: Printed on every invoice. Fill in the GSTIN, address and bank details before the first invoice.
billing.dayCountHelp: Default: the start day counts, the end day does not, and a Brigade held for part of a day counts that day.
billing.partDay: A Brigade held part of a day counts the day
billing.creditBlockHelp: Block new bookings and dispatch requests for clients who are over their credit limit or overdue. An administrator can override a client.
billing.blockOverLimit: Block when over the credit limit
billing.blockOverdueDays: Block when an invoice is overdue by more than (days)
billing.emailHelp: The Resend API key is stored as an Edge Function secret, never here.
billing.razorpayHelp: Keys and the webhook secret are Edge Function secrets, never here.
billing.occupancyHelp: The snapshot runs every night at 00:05 India time. Run this after downtime to fill any missed day; it never changes a day already stored.
billing.recomputeHelp: Use this only after correcting allocation dates. Days already on an invoice are never recomputed.

rates.title: Rate Cards
rates.cardsHelp: Rates are looked up in this order: client, client group, warehouse default, global default. A rate that was used on an invoice is never edited: add a new version.
rates.scopeHelp: Client rates win over group, warehouse and global rates.
rates.freeDaysHelp: The first days of each Brigade are not charged.
rates.minDaysHelp: A shorter stay is topped up to this many days.
rates.versionHelp: The current rate is closed on {{date}} and the new one starts on the date below.
rates.usedHelp: Used on an invoice: it can only be closed, never edited.
rates.tierHelp: Applies when this many Brigades are held on the day.
rates.multiplierHelp: 1 = no change, 1.5 = one and a half times
rates.chargesHelp: Optional charges that can be added to a draft invoice: each is fixed or a percentage, with its own SAC code.
rates.taxHelp: Suggested SAC codes and 18% GST are defaults. Confirm them with your accountant before issuing real invoices.
rates.testerHelp: Pick a client, warehouse and date to see which rate applies and why. Rates higher in the list lose to the first one.
rates.testerPick: Choose a client and a warehouse.
rates.noRateApplies: No rate applies. Invoices cannot be generated until a rate card covers this case.

cold.liveSubtitle: Current temperature of every zone. Figures update by themselves; each shows when it was last updated.
cold.gapNote: A gap in a line means no data was received for that time.
cold.allSensorsOk: All sensors are reporting and calibrated.
cold.resolveHelp: Write what caused it and what was done. This stays in the record.
cold.linkEquipmentHelp: If a machine caused it, link it so its service history shows the fault.
cold.evStart: Event start (first reading out of range)
cold.noAffected: No client stock was in this zone during the event.
cold.subject: Subject
cold.noticeHelp: A client is told only when its stock was affected, and only after a manager approves the wording.
cold.badRange: The end must be after the start.
cold.serialHelp: The code the device sends (printed on it).
cold.keyShownOnce: Copy this key now. It is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
cold.calibrationHelp: Compare the sensor with a reference thermometer. The difference is applied to every new reading; the raw value is kept too.
cold.nextDueHelp: Blank = one year after this date (setting).
cold.rawHelp: The raw value the sensor reports.
cold.manualHelp: Use this while sensors are not installed. It feeds alerts and reports like a sensor.
cold.impossibleValue: That temperature is not possible (−60 to 80 °C).
cold.outsideRangeWarn: This is outside the zone's range. Saving it will raise an alert.
cold.rulesHelp: Tolerance, delays and levels for each zone. Blank fields use the defaults.
cold.rulesDefaultNote: Blank limits use the zone's own range.
cold.defrostHelp: High readings inside these India-time windows are ignored.
cold.serviceIntervalHelp: The next task is scheduled when one is completed.
cold.clientReportHelp: Shows only the zones and days this client's stock was stored there. Out of range is measured against the zone limits.
cold.noStockPeriod: No stock was stored in any zone in this period.
cold.noLorry: No lorry temperatures in this period.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Everyone who works for you, with their joining and leaving dates.
staff.none: No staff yet. People appear here when you create their login.
staff.exitHelp: Their login is switched off. All their records stay.
staff.sensitiveNote: Private. Only the administrator can see this. It is never shown in lists and the activity log keeps only stars.
staff.promoteNote: Saving makes this person a warehouse manager of their warehouse (login role changes). They must sign out and in again.

att.title: Attendance
att.subtitle: Check in when you arrive and check out when you leave.
att.doneOutside: Saved. You are away from the warehouse, so your manager will see a note.
att.savedOffline: No signal. Saved on this phone and will be sent when you are online.
att.reportHelp: A spreadsheet of everyone's check-in and check-out for the month, with hours.

crew.title: Workers on this lorry
crew.help: For reports only. It does not change what the client is billed.

managers.title: Managers of {{name}}
managers.lastWarning: This is the last manager. The warehouse would have nobody to approve documents.

offline.title: Waiting on this phone
offline.explain: Entries made without signal are kept here and sent in order when you are online. Nothing is overwritten without asking you.
offline.savedOnPhone: No signal. Saved on this phone.
offline.savedNoPhoto: No signal. Saved on this phone (the photo was not saved: add it later).
offline.gateQueued: Lorry saved on this phone. It will be sent when you are online.
offline.scanQueued: Scan saved on this phone for {{slot}}.
offline.changedMeanwhile: Someone changed this meanwhile. Reloaded: check and enter it again.
offline.conflict: Someone else changed this. The server has: {{value}}

dash.changeRequests: client detail change(s) waiting for approval

docs.title: My documents
docs.subtitle: Receipts, challans, invoices, credit notes and temperature reports as PDF.

support.title: Support
support.subtitleClient: Ask us anything about your stock, dispatches or invoices.
support.subject: Subject

profile.title: My details
profile.subtitle: Ask us to change your company details. We check and approve each change.
profile.requestSent: Sent. We will tell you when it is approved.
profile.pending: A change you asked for on {{date}} is waiting for approval.
profile.contacts: People to tell about temperature alerts
profile.contactsHelp: These people get an email when your stock is affected (after our manager approves the message).

notices.title: Notifications
notices.subtitle: Stock received, dispatches, invoices, payments, reminders and replies.

imports.title: Data import
imports.subtitle: Start with real data: clients, companies, opening stock and opening balances.
imports.missingColumn: The file needs a column called {{name}}

kinds.opening_stock: Opening stock (per Brigade slot and batch)

help.clients: One row per client. company_name is required. Amounts are in rupees.
help.companies: One row per sender or receiver. client_code must already exist.
help.opening_stock: One row per batch in a slot. The slot must be free or already holding the same client's goods, and in a zone that suits the temperature.
help.opening_balances: One row per client: positive = the client owes you, negative = advance held. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

ops.title: System health
ops.subtitle: Scheduled jobs, backups, sign-in security and how long records are kept.
ops.cronHelp: Nightly snapshots, invoice runs, alerts and backups. A job that failed or did not run on time is shown in red here and on your dashboard.
ops.backupHelp: A second copy of the key tables, kept 14 days in private storage. Supabase's own backups are separate.
ops.mfaHelp: Ask for a code from an authenticator app every time the administrator signs in.
ops.mfaVerifyFirst: Enter the code from your app once, then you can switch this on.
ops.mfaRequire: Require two-factor sign-in for the administrator
ops.passwordRules: Passwords need at least 10 characters with a capital letter, a small letter and a number.
ops.retentionHelp: Old notices, sent emails and job logs are cleared after these many days.
ops.retentionFinancial: Invoices, payments, receipts and challans are never deleted.

mfa.title: Second step
mfa.required: A code from your authenticator app is needed to continue.
mfa.enrolHelp: Use an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar).
mfa.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.wrongCode: That code did not work. Try the new one.

features.title: Features
features.help: Switch parts of the app off for now. They disappear from the menus and cannot be opened. Switch them back on any time.
features.offBody: The administrator has switched this feature off for now.

advice.title: Inward Advice
advice.helpClient: Tell the warehouse what is coming. It is optional and helps the gate receive your lorry faster.
advice.helpStaff: Consignments clients have announced. Tap Arrived when the lorry is at the gate and the gate entry is made for you.
advice.arrivedDone: Gate entry created. Check it, then receive the goods.

quickBill.title: Bill {{name}}
quickBill.help: Calculates all rent and labour not yet invoiced, including today, and issues the GST invoice. Today counts as a full day.
quickBill.recorded: Payment recorded and matched to this invoice.
quickBill.note: Today is billed as a full day, including a slot emptied by today's dispatch. Anything done after you issue this invoice goes on the next one.
